old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-mvuu","title":"Expose and dispatch durable gateway coordination state in lichend","description":"P1 correctness/integration: rust/lichen-gateway/src/bin/lichend.rs provisions or loads a persistent TrustStore and GatewayCoordinator, passes them into Gateway, and then only runs radio/TUN loops. Repository-wide searches show Gateway::coordinator_mut and Gateway::trust_store have no call sites; the trust store is exposed read-only. Consequently no /gw/info, /gw/slots, /gw/channels, /gw/handoff, or /gw/nodes request is dispatched through GatewayCoordinator::handle_request, no production peer can be added/upgraded in the durable trust store, and slot claims cannot affect runtime gateway state despite successful persistence initialization. Add an authenticated CoAP/GCP dispatch path that binds the OSCORE peer identity/pubkey to the durable TrustStore, persists trust mutations/floors atomically, and exposes coordinator state to the runtime; add restart/integration tests that exercise the production lichend path rather than only direct coordinator unit calls.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T14:59:47.559492Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T14:59:47.559492Z"}
